title: Uncovering Business Logic Bugs via Semantics-Driven Unit Test Generation (Experience Paper)
datasets: Four proprietary ByteDance Go production repositories, 60 confirmed high-severity business logic bugs (Subjects 1–4: 12/9/37/2).
Six additional internal production repositories for deployment RQ3; 16 newly found bugs fixed by developers. No Defects4J/BugsInPy/SWT-Bench.
task: Semantics-driven Go unit test generation and bug detection from PRDs/business requirements, not historical bug reproduction.
input_setting: Private PRD converted to normalized functionality entries, focal method/repository context used to retrieve relevant functionality and derive scenarios (preconditions, action, expected outcome, constraints), then generate and compile-repair tests. Tests run against current MR code; assertion failure/panic matching annotated ground-truth bug counts as detection.
author_relationship_evidence: Paper Data Availability links Li et al. 2026/project homepage; GitHub README names SeGa and explicitly describes repository as the core semantic reasoning agent implementation.
license: No repository license in GitHub API/root tree; paper CC BY 4.0 does not provide an explicit source-code license.
exact_models: Paper: SeedCode LLM via API for SeGa and baselines; model snapshot/weights not published.
Public core source supports configurable SeedCode, Claude, and DeepSeek/OpenAI-compatible model clients.
weights_status: No weights or fine-tuning included. Headline SeedCode endpoint is proprietary/unavailable to independent researchers unless separately provisioned; alternatives can run but will not reproduce exact reported results.
evaluation_route: Public repository includes core semantic-reasoning agent, prompts, Go AST/code-inspection tools, Swerex runtime, Docker support and desensitized examples. It omits the four evaluated production repositories, PRDs, 60 labeled bug cases, and six deployment repositories/results due industrial confidentiality. No benchmark artifacts or quantitative output files present. Static code/tree inspection only; no code execution/API calls.
blockers: Core algorithm is public, but the private ByteDance source, PRDs, 60 bug annotations and evaluation/deployment data are not released, preventing replication of the main study.
The paper’s SeedCode model API/weights are not publicly specified. Replacing with Claude/DeepSeek changes the model and cannot reproduce the reported baseline or SeGa metrics.
Repository has no software license and includes a tracked .env with short credential-field literals (values withheld); review/credential hygiene is needed before any reuse.
The experience evaluation is Go/enterprise-only and relies on dev-confirmed behavior; business requirement semantics and intended responsibility boundaries are domain-specific.
concept_fit: Very high concept fit: explicit business intent, functionality, individual requirements, scenario preconditions/actions/outcomes/constraints, plus semantic retrieval. This is direct prior work for concept-guided tests and business-logic oracle design, but not historical-bug reproduction.
recommendation: High-priority related work for thesis novelty and concept representation; the functionality→business-scenario DSL is a close prior art for semantic obligations. However, do not use it as a reproducible experimental baseline unless industrial data/PRDs and a permitted model route become available. Analyze public core code for design only; do not reimplement without approval.
supporting_locations: Pinned README explicitly characterizes package as core semantic reasoning agent; source-audit summary in papers/sega/public_evidence/source-audit.json.
No evaluation dataset/results or requirements-document corpus in 111-entry GitHub tree.
